post_freeze_additions.label: summary
post_freeze_additions.purpose: study summary written from RESULTS.json, VERIFIED.json and posthoc/h1_tier_diagnosis.json

disclosures: H4 compares mean surviving-set sizes. Permuting EMHs or analogies across classes keeps the multiset of compiled knowledge prototypes, so set size can change only through the knowledge-bucket calibration rows; the contrast had little power by construction. Coverage of the true class is the informative comparison and did not differ (0.943 vs 0.943 for EMH vs shuffled EMH on drugs of unobserved classes). This is a design limitation recorded after the run, not a change to any verdict.
